extracted.intended_audience: life-science researchers, manuscript authors, and journal editors
extracted.subtask_description: Describes Review Commons, a platform providing journal-independent, expert peer review of life-science manuscripts before journal submission; produces refereed preprints (manuscript + reviewer reports + author responses) that can be transferred to affiliate journals. Focus is on evaluating rigor, suggesting improvements, and assessing community value to speed editorial decisions and reduce repeated re-review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Evaluate the technical rigor of the work
rubrics_metrics.description: The peer reviewers will be asked to evaluate the technical rigor of the work.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reviewers are expected to assess methodological soundness and technical correctness so editors and authors can judge the solidity of the findings; this evaluation forms a core element of the Refereed Preprint used to inform editorial decisions and authors' choice of journal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Make suggestions for improvements
rubrics_metrics.description: Reviewers will be asked to make suggestions for improvements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reviews should be constructive and identify ways the manuscript can be strengthened; such suggestions are included in the Refereed Preprint and help authors revise before journal submission or decide on an appropriate home.

rubrics_metrics.name: Comment on the potential value to specific communities
rubrics_metrics.description: Reviewers will be asked to comment on the potential value of the work to specific communities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assessing audience/community relevance helps authors and editors determine fit for particular journals and fields; reviewers should indicate which research communities are likely to find the work valuable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Produce a Refereed Preprint (manuscript + reviewers' reports + author responses)
rubrics_metrics.description: The resulting Refereed Preprint, containing the manuscript, the reviewers' reports plus any author responses.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Refereed Preprint packages the manuscript together with reviewer reports and author responses to empower authors to choose an appropriate journal and to provide editors and readers with richer context about the peer review history.

rubrics_metrics.name: Offer Transparent Review in Preprints (TRiP) posting option
rubrics_metrics.description: Authors can direct Review Commons to post reviews and their own responses to bioRxiv through the server's new Transparent Review in Preprints (TRiP) project.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Posting reviews and responses publicly provides rich context for readers of the preprint and increases transparency; this is an author-directed option intended to make review content discoverable alongside the preprint.

rubrics_metrics.name: Journal-independent, pre-submission peer review
rubrics_metrics.description: A platform for high-quality, journal-independent peer review of manuscripts from the life sciences before submission to a journal.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: By decoupling peer review from immediate journal submission, reviews become reusable across journals, reducing repeated re-review and helping accelerate the publication workflow and reduce delays caused by sequential journal rejections.

rubrics_metrics.name: Affiliate journals' commitment to consider transferred reviews without restarting review process
rubrics_metrics.description: A consortium of 17 journals across six publishers have joined the project by committing to use the Review Commons referee reports for their independent editorial decisions, and to seek minimal additional expert input.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Affiliate journals agree to consider the transferred reviews (rather than restarting review), allowing editors to make efficient editorial decisions based on existing referee comments; if an editor rejects, authors may reuse the peer review evaluation for other journals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Facilitate transfer of manuscript, reviews, and responses to affiliate journals
rubrics_metrics.description: Review Commons will facilitate transfer of the manuscript, reviews, and responses to affiliate journals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The platform provides a mechanism to transmit the full review package to participating journals to expedite editorial handling and reduce redundant review cycles.
